meta.title: taskfw scope resolution — how a task's `scope` string is derived
meta.frame: Not a knowledge-domain graph like the ontology/*-domain.json files in other repos -- this is a decision-path graph: given an input, which branch fires and what string comes out. Terminal nodes are the three possible scope prefixes.

relation_types.reads: the left node is consulted to decide the right node's branch
relation_types.produces: taking this path yields the string described at the target
relation_types.overrides: if present, this input is used instead of the default
relation_types.falls_back_to: used only when the preceding attempt fails or is absent

nodes.label: cwd argument to derive()
nodes.definition: Optional explicit directory a caller passes to derive(cwd=...). Almost always omitted.

nodes.label: TASKFW_SCOPE env var
nodes.definition: If set, overrides which directory is asked about -- NOT the answer itself. Rarely set.

nodes.label: os.getcwd() of the taskfw MCP server process
nodes.definition: The real default. This is the long-lived MCP server's own OS working directory, fixed at process launch (session start) -- NOT the harness-reported 'current working directory', NOT wherever an agent's Bash tool has `cd`'d to. Nothing an agent does mid-session moves this.

nodes.label: resolved directory
nodes.definition: caller_cwd_arg, else taskfw_scope_env, else server_process_cwd -- whichever is present, resolved to an absolute path.

nodes.label: git remote get-url origin
nodes.definition: Run in resolved_cwd. Any failure (not a repo, no origin, git missing/hung) is treated identically -- no error, just 'no remote knowable here'.

nodes.label: git:<host>/<path>
nodes.definition: Normalised, lowercased host+path from the origin URL (SSH and HTTPS spellings collapse to the same string). Coarser than a directory -- a monorepo's sub-projects all share one scope.

nodes.label: path:<abs>
nodes.definition: Fallback when resolved_cwd has no discoverable git origin. Machine-local; does not survive a move or a second checkout.

nodes.label: hint:<raw text>
nodes.definition: for_repo()-only path: a caller-supplied repo string (e.g. from tasks__add_commit) that isn't a real directory and isn't already a scope. Kept verbatim, unresolved, so it can never be confused with a derived answer.

nodes.label: repo string passed to for_repo()
nodes.definition: Used by tasks__add_commit's repo argument and backfill. Four sub-cases: empty, already-prefixed, a real directory, or free text.

watch_next.pitfall: Every task created in a session is scoped to server_process_cwd (wherever the session began) unless a caller explicitly passes a real, different directory to for_repo(), or tasks__update(scope=...) corrects it after the fact. See loop memory: taskfw-scope-pins-to-server-process-cwd.
